title: 1.5 Applications of Sequence and Series
description: Ten challenging applied problems on compound interest, depreciation, population growth, and series totals.

questions.question: How much does 2000 birr become after 3 years at 5% compound interest per year?
A salary starts at 6000 birr and increases by 400 birr each year. What is the total earned over 5 years?
A population of 5000 grows by 2% each year. What is the population after 3 years?
A car worth 800000 birr depreciates by 15% each year. What is its value after 2 years?
Monthly deposits start at 100 birr and rise by 50 birr each month for 12 months. What is the total deposited?
A radioactive sample of 80 g decays with a half-life of one year. How much remains after 3 years?
A bacteria culture of 100 doubles every hour. What is the count after 4 hours?
For the same principal, rate, and time, compound interest is generally ... simple interest.
How much does 5000 birr become after 2 years at 8% compound interest per year?
How much does 10000 birr become after 2 years at 10% compound interest per year?
